label: Claim Evidence
description: Draft portrait package for claim validation, bounded evidence review, benchmark audit, corrective framing, and source comparison.

renderCost.notes: Fixed portrait evidence surfaces with lightweight frame-driven entrances.

reducedMotion.notes: Reduce and static policies preserve all claim and evidence geometry.

accessibility.notes: Textual support labels and confidence values are never conveyed by color alone.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Use when a conclusion must remain visibly bounded by supporting, weakening, or contextual evidence.
hardBlocks: Registration remains pending outside this package ownership.

sourcePolicy.notes: Draft implementation uses local fixtures and Lucida shared primitives only. No approved source or visual-pattern claim is made.

tokens.palette: neutral charcoal with teal context, green support, red weakening, and amber uncertainty
tokens.typography: UI sans for claims and evidence summaries with monospace confidence values

layoutGrammar: Keep the conclusion bounded by visible evidence.
Use textual support, weaken, and context labels with color.
Reserve a fixed lower confidence and verdict panel.
Do not animate panel dimensions or reorder evidence.
Do not convert provisional evidence into an approval claim.

componentPrimitives.notes: Source, direction, detail, and bounded strength.
Confidence value, verdict, and confidence bar.

selectedConcepts: visible hierarchy and grouping for bounded evidence reading
inspectable evidence rows and compact data surfaces
bounded verdict hierarchy and readable supporting text

checks: local still render pending or fail-closed
knownLimitations: This draft is not registered for runtime selection.
